Vacancy for Nursing Tutor and Occupational Therapist (updated with Corrigendum)
Wednesday, 30 April 2025
2787 Hits
CORRIGENDUM
In reference to the earlier advertisement posted in Punyanagari on 03/05/2025 for the post of Occupational Therapist in the daily Punyanagari newspaper on 03/05/2025, the Qualification & Experience criteria and last date for submission may be read as follows:
Last Date for Submission of Application
: 15/05/2025
Qualification & Experience:
Bachelor of Occupational Therapy from a recognized university. Minimum two years of experience as an Occupational Therapist in a hospital, with experience handling 500 or more cases per year.
Medical Superintendent
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Applications are invited in the prescribed format, along with attested copies of educational qualifications and experience certificates, for the following post. The application should reach the
Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram, Dist. Wardha – 442102
on or before
10/05/2025
. (Please refer to the above corrigendum as updated on 08/05/2025)
1) Nursing Tutor – 01 Post (1- EWS)
Qualification & Experience:
Master Degree in Nursing recognized by Indian Nursing Council or B. Sc. Nursing (Basic / Post Basic) or Diploma in Nursing Education and Administration with minimum 2 years of teaching experience.
Must have valid Maharashtra Nursing Council (MNC) Registration.
2)
Occupational Therapist – 1 Post (Open Category)
Qualification & Experience:
Bachelor or of Occupational Therapy from recognized university. One-year experience in 100 bedded hospital as Occupational Therapist.
Medical Superintendent
General Notes
Candidates applying for reserve category post should submit caste certificate & caste validity certificate and also recent non-creamy layer certificate, wherever applicable.
The benefits of reservation shall be admissible to the backward class/ category candidates who are domiciled in the state of Maharashtra only.
Registration with Local Employment Exchange is mandatory.
Age limit, Educational Qualifications and experience shall be considered up-to last date of the application.
NOC certificate from the present employer is mandatory.
Age limit and or Experience can be relaxed by the appointing authority for otherwise qualified candidate.
Only eligible candidates will be called for Written / Skill test and shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification / Interview.
No of post may vary
Pay Scale is as per KHS rule
Swachhata Pakhwada - 2025
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
